test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

We must / take care / of one other / in times of crisis.
solution:
The correct answer is **"of one other". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in the phrase **"of one other". **
 
• The correct phrase should be **"of each other" **when referring to mutual support or actions between two or more parties.
 
• **"Each other" **is used when two entities are involved, and **"one another" **is traditionally used for more than two, but the sentence indicates a general situation implying two or more people supporting each other during crises, hence **"each other" **or **"one another" **could fit, but not **"one other".**
 
• The error changes the meaning of the sentence by making it grammatically incorrect and causing confusion about the intended message of mutual support.
 
• The corrected sentence would read: **"We must take care of each other in times of crisis." **ensuring clarity and correctness in conveying the importance of mutual support during difficult times.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• We must - This segment sets the tone for imperative or strong advice, suggesting an action that needs to be taken.
 
 
• It is grammatically correct.
 
 
 
• take care - This phrase is correctly used in this context to imply looking after or supporting one another.
 
 
• It stands as a common expression for showing concern and kindness.
 
 
 
• in times of crisis - Refers to periods of difficulty or emergency.
 
 
• This segment correctly indicates when the action of taking care of one another is especially emphasized.
